generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a tall, narrow conifer with a drooping leader, slender level to drooping branches and feathery, flat sprays of short needles in two ranks; very shade tolerant. Not fitted to measurements. Cones (plant forms F3): 1.5 to 3 cm hang from the shoot tips; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Spray area (plant roadmap P4): the area its card draws with needles of their true length. Growth plan G1 (2026-10-08): grown by the `pinaceae` program, so branches ramify into fronds clothed in needles rather than bare whips with a tuft at the tip: each year's shoot sets lateral buds by its length (side_chance on each side once lateral_length long, fewer on shorter shoots), laterals of laterals do the same to side_order deep, and side shoots live while they have light. Same values as Douglas-fir (side_order 2, lateral_length 0.35, side_chance 0.6, in place of its earlier 0.85), which the Urban Tree Database fits; it has no western hemlocks. At 60 years in the open it holds about 16 m² of leaf per m² of crown, more than Douglas-fir's 11 as the most shade-tolerant of the four, and side renders are about 9 % see-through (35 % before). Not fitted to measurements of this species.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 33 m tall and 45 cm across at breast height at 60 years in a closed stand. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: soft dark green needles with paler undersides; dark reddish-brown furrowed bark. Needle shoots (plant roadmap P4): flat needles of mixed lengths, 0.5 to 2 cm long and 1.5 to 2 mm wide, so a needle 0.12 as wide as it is long (`width`), and needles about 1.2 cm on a spray 25 cm long (`needle` 0.047), from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): thin dark reddish-brown bark furrowed into flat ridges; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.
